posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:
If you turned the single sprite into a sheet and it jitters, then your placements on a few of the cells was off. Putting on grid lines is very helpful if you didnt have them enabled.
You want the sheet's total to be exactly 9x6 the size of the single battler and you need to make sure every cell is aligned properly
